chapter: Los Angeles 1947-48, Rock Island and bebop in New York
title: The Bellson-Shavers combo in Rock Island and Hank Jones's departure
summary: A vacation combo with Bellson, Shavers, DeFranco and Hank Jones; Hank left after horseplay over his long underwear.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: After City College in '47-'48, '49, isn't that when you started working with Errol Garner?
Yeah, but I went back to New York in '48 and had another collision (Laughter). Tommy Dorsey went on vacation, so Louis Bellson and Charlie Shavers co-led a combo in Moline.
Louis' home town.
Huh?
Louis' home town.
Rock Island. Moline --
Moline is Louis' home town.
Yeah. Well, we were working in Rock Island.
Uh-huh.
What's across the bridge, Davenport? The tri-cities?
I'm not sure.
Anyway, we get there --
Tape Seven
You were telling me on the last tape about a combo that was co-led by Louis Bellson and Charlie Shavers and that your first date was in Rock Island, Illinois. Who was in the group?
Louis Bellson, Buddy de Franco, Charlie

Shavers, Hank Jones and myself. Hank never played a note. And Hank -- I mean, Charlie and Buddy de Franco and Louis Bellson were on vacation from Tommy's band at the time. So this was a filler for them, you know, playing his home town and everything, you know. Local boy returns home, you know.
How was it that Hank never played a note?
Well, we offended him in a manner that he didn't particularly care for.
Who offended him?

Charlie and I. We were playing with him, and he was serious, you know, about his underclothing, why he never took them off, you know. Like he was dressed and I for winter, he wore long johns, and Charlie would strip down to the waist, you know, or else take a bath. So Charlie would take a bath and I would take half a bath, and he's over at the face bowl, washing, you know. Of course the water is running from the faucets in the face bowl, you know. He's getting running water.
This was where you were staying in Rock Island?
Yeah.
Moline.
Yeah. Open house, international house, something like that. You have to walk through
everyone's room to get to the bathroom. All you're supposed to do is sleep and get to work, you know. So --
Your accomodations were in Rock Island or Moline?

Rock Island. So this was before Mr. Bellson cut up his living room and made two bedrooms for Charlie and I, and after Charlie and I had our little horseplay with Hank, he dressed and got out of the house in a hurry, and when we got to work that night, there was no Hank. So we did what we do in my profession when there's no piano player. It's called the strollers, and then when the piano comes in, that builds up to a climactic thing, and then the horns come in and it still gets stronger, you know?
